checks: Native text undo and delete retained the design and component selection.
Selected hidden member deleted its complete recipe and all ports, preserved interleaved solids and shared material, exported exact geometry, and restored original selection.
Delete and both redo shortcuts worked in XY; a committed rename after undo discarded the obsolete redo branch.
Explicit detachment permitted a single-solid delete; two undos restored first the solid and then its parametric membership and ports.
Delete to an empty scene and undo/redo both survived same-tab reloads. The restored selection and subsequent new geometry remained editable.
A fresh tab ignored inherited undo history; external draft conflict paused autosave and reload rejected the old checkpoint.
A full tab history store preserved the separately saved draft and in-memory undo, and prevented recovery of stale history.
